headline: Orient Technologies Limited files SEBI Takeover Code Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial share acquisition
sum: Orient Technologies Limited made a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code, indicating a substantial share acquisition meeting or exceeding the 25% threshold. The acquiring entity, transaction value, and share count remain confidential pending formal public announcement.
implication: Pre-announcement Reg 31(4) filings signal imminent takeover announcement; counsel must immediately prepare Form A documentation, fair value assessment, and due diligence closure conditions as the formal offer is likely days to weeks away.
detail: Orient Technologies Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, a procedural step that precedes formal public announcement of substantial share acquisition or takeover intent under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when a person proposes to acquire or has acquired shares exceeding 25% of paid-up capital or voting rights, or proposes to acquire control. The acquiring entity name, consideration amount, and exact shareholding acquired have not been disclosed in accessible public sources as of the filing date, consistent with the confidentiality protocol preceding formal announcement.
